verdict.description: the FINAL call. approve only if nothing in resolved_items has severity blocker

resolved_items.description: the merged, deduplicated worklist handed to the writer. One entry per real problem, however many reviewers raised it. Omit anything you are overruling.

instruction.description: one concrete instruction to the writer. If two reviewers asked for different things here, this is the single reconciled instruction, not both.

needs_human.description: true when the code genuinely does not determine the answer, so an @note NEEDS-HUMAN must remain

disagreements.description: every place the two reviewers conflicted, or where you overruled a reviewer. This is the audit trail; an empty array means the reviewers agreed and you deferred to them throughout.

accuracy_position.description: what the accuracy reviewer wanted; empty string if it said nothing here

style_position.description: what the style reviewer wanted; empty string if it said nothing here

rationale.description: why, grounded in the code or the house rules
